description: These annotations demonstrate traceability. They are neither model-generated extractions nor approved Aurevion policies.

claims.title: Interpret protein timing alongside total intake
claims.population: Populations represented in the protein-timing meta-analysis
claims.note: Inspect the underlying studies, intake adjustment, outcomes and limitations before approving a recommendation.

claims.title: Distinguish training frequency from weekly volume
claims.population: Populations represented in the strength-frequency meta-analysis
claims.note: A frequency comparison can be confounded by different weekly training volumes.

claims.title: Keep adherence observations tied to their studied population
claims.population: Previously sedentary post-menopausal women in a supervised programme
claims.note: Observational and population-specific findings are candidates for product research, not universal causal rules.

decisions.title: Explain the basis of a nutrition suggestion
decisions.rationale: Expose what informed a suggestion, who was studied, and which questions remain unresolved.

decisions.title: Explain schedule tradeoffs and missing context
decisions.rationale: Review volume, feasibility and population fit before turning a schedule preference into a rule.
